cells.quote: Interestingly, our study revealed that the RSD of CRA trials had a positive monotonic relationship with the accuracy of CRA responses.

O.outcome_detail: Relationship between CRA reaction time and RSD

cells.quote: These changes suggest that tDCS stimulation of the bilateral IFG may modify the natural cognitive processes involved in solving CRA tasks. Notably, these alterations were neutral, as the overall CRA performance was comparable across all groups.
cells.note: Relative to Sham, the U-shaped RSD–reaction-time relationship disappeared in the L+R− group; the outcome is a process-pattern change rather than an overall performance advantage.

O.outcome_detail: Relationship between CRA reaction time and RSD

cells.note: The Sham group showed a U-shaped relationship, whereas the L−R+ group showed a monotonically decreasing relationship; the reported interaction terms were not statistically significant.
